name: Repo Man
tagline: 4:07 am on a cul-de-sac: Gary works a loan checklist up the multiplier while the owner watches through the blinds over a chart that stays green. The supercar, the hose, the TV, the kid's bike with a bow on it, the smart fridge, the porch: every rung stacks more of the house on his flatbed. Cash out and run down in your socks to buy it all back, or watch the beacons come on and the front door ride off seatbelted.
